**Before you leave:** colour the stars for each line. 1 star = I need help. 4 stars = I can teach it.

**离开教室前：**给每一行涂星星。1颗星 = 我需要帮助。4颗星 = 我能教别人。

## 1. I can…

| I can… 我能… | How well? 掌握得怎么样？ |
|:--|:-:|
| name five kinds of angle. 说出五种角的名称。 | ☆ ☆ ☆ ☆ |
| find angles around me. 找到身边的角。 | ☆ ☆ ☆ ☆ |
| compare angles with *bigger than* and *smaller than*. 用 *bigger than* 和 *smaller than* 比较角。 | ☆ ☆ ☆ ☆ |

: {tbl-colwidths="[68,32]"}

## 2. Show me

Draw an angle **bigger than** a right angle. Name it.

{{< drawing-box height="1.4in" >}}

Its name: {{< blank 2in >}}

## 3. One sentence

Use this frame: *A {{< blank >}} angle is {{< blank >}} than a right angle.*

{{< lines 2 >}}

::: {.content-visible when-profile="teacher"}
**Look-fors:** a 1 or 2 on any line: see that student first next lesson. Part 2: an obtuse angle (or a straight or full angle, with a reason). Part 3: the frame used with *bigger* or *smaller*, and an angle name that matches.
:::
